title: Range Sum of Sorted Subarray Sums
summary: Given an array of n positive integers, compute the sum of all non-empty continuous subarrays, sort these sums, and return the sum of elements from index left to right in the sorted array, modulo 10^9 + 7.
statement: Given an array of n positive integers, compute the sum of all non-empty continuous subarrays, sort these sums, and return the sum of elements from index left to right in the sorted array, modulo 10^9 + 7.
constraints: nums contains positive integers and n equals its length.
Sort all contiguous non-empty subarray sums and add ranks left through right, using one-based ranks.
hints: Generate each contiguous subarray sum using a running total per start index.
Slice from left-1 through right and sum modulo the modulus.
Generation covers every contiguous interval once, and the adjusted slice matches the one-based inclusive ranks.
editorial: Generation covers every contiguous interval once, and the adjusted slice matches the one-based inclusive ranks.
